translation.name: Habo nalolene bi gahenge lo winigo ogo

book.name: MADIU
book.title: Madiu Madiuhanda Bi Mana Debene gili binigo ogo

content: Mamalime ilili biagane winigo ogo
Ani biyagola howa Perisi agali maru hearubi Mana lo winigo lawai haga maru hearubi Yarusaleme howa Yasu hearia íbu ngoai ho howa tigua ibuhondo lalu,
Í̠naga talima piaga karume bamba inanaga mamalime ilili biagane wini ngago pugualu gi wayawaya nabi howa tomo nalu kagoni agidabe, lene.
Ani layagola Yasuhanda tihondo ladai bialu lalu, Anidago tígua nde Ngode Datagaliwabehanda bi lo ngadagua bia nabi tíninaga mana hangu yu tiga biaabo halu kamigo irane aginagabe.
Ogoninaga Ngode Datagaliwabehanda lalu, Í̠naga aba ai̱yabi mo yo handa nabi laradagua hale halu bibe, lalu, Mbiralime ibu aba ai̱yabi ha hayagua nde ibu homelo bolene nga, lene.
Anidagua ndo tígua agua lawai haramili. Mbiralime mbirale ibunaga winigome ibu aba ai̱yayaguabi biamogo bulene howa ibugua lalu, Mbirale uruni Ngode Datagaliwabehondo loma bia ho ngo, layagua
ibu aba ai̱yala biamogo bulene nawi lawai haramiligoni. Tígua mana ogoni beramigome Ngode Datagaliwabehanda mana lo winigo wahalu tíninaga mana lawai halu kami.
Tí tombene hondo kihe kamirunaga Ngode Datagaliwabe mana latagi haga Aisaiahanda mbiwia halu tí layagoore tigatigada, lene. Mbiwia hene lo ngago ogo,

content.text: Ngode Datagaliwabehanda lalu, Wali agali urunime tinaga mini do howa
bime dege i̱naga mini yaraga haga ka.
Tigua Ngode Datagaliwabehanda bi lowinigo lawai harama lalu howa agalime mana lo winigo dege lawai haga ka.
Anigo tigua i̱naga mini nagalone halu mo yaraga habe nahe,

content: lenego gilibu nga, lalu Yasuhanda lamini.
Wali agali mo ko hagane tene ogo
Ani lowa Yasuhanda wali agali dewaore bu hearu olalu, Ibidaba, lowa tihondo lalu, I̱na bi o larogo hale halu manda bilimu.
Ne harigaha anda poragome wali agali mo ko nahaga. Bu miniha howa mitangi tagira ibiragome wali agali mo ko haga, lene.
Ani layagola ibunaga talima piaga biarume Yasu hearia ibuwa lalu, Í̠na bi o lareruninaga Perisi agali karuha anda puwa ti miniha tandaga halu kagoni manda bidebe, lene.
Ani layagola Yasuhanda ladai bialu lalu, Mbirale bibahende i̱ Aba dahuliya andaga kagome hengene ndogo minu duguai holebira.

Perisi agali biaru tí mitangi nabilimu. Tinibi de kohe howa de kohe dege maru karu haru piaga kago. De kohe mbiragome de kohe mende haru pialu kagola libu haru kirabali gana habaneha pilo pagupagu bu wulebira, lene.
Ani layagola Pidahanda la daga halu lalu, Ina manda buluma̱ya bi yobage larigoni irane langi, lene.
Ani layagola Yasuhanda ladai bialu lalu, Tí nde mini nawi maru karudagua dege kamigoni.
Tí manda nabiore kamibe. Mbirale ne harigaha anda porago pialu tombeneha puabo halu tagira piaga.
Mbirale ne harigaha howa tagira ibiragome bu miniha howa tagira ibalu urunime wali agali mo ko haga.
Irane bu miniha howa tagira ibiragome ko manda bialu homelo bolenebi wali agali kayu yaga bulenebi tingininaga ko tara bulenebi dabudabu kayu bulenebi ke̱ holenebi la hirulenebi

mbirale urunibi bulene bu miniha howa tagira ibiragome wali agali mo ko haga. Anigo tigua tí gi wayawaya biagane winidadagua bulene nga lalu laralidagua nabi howa tomo naramigome mbirali mo ko nahaga, lene.
Wali mbirame Yasuhondo mini mbiraore winigo ogo
Yasu ibu dindi ogoni wahalu dindi Taia tanohayagibi Saidono tanohayagibi pene.
Ani piyagola Kenana wali mbira dindi ogoniha berenego ibu Yasu hearia ibuwa ibuhondo lalu, Debidi Igini-o i̱ dara howa biamogo berene. I̱ waneha dama daraga howa mo ko harago, lene.

Ani layagola Yasuhanda wali biagohondo bi mbira ladai nabiore hene. Ibu ema nabi heagola ibunaga talima piaga biarume ibu hearia ibuwa Yasuhondo lalu, Wali o ibiragome ina poramadagua bi hale pobobi lama ibirago ibuhondo, Pu, la, lene.
Ani layagola Yasuhanda ladai bialu lalu, Isaraele wali agali nogo sibi pu ereba hene ale karu ti hangu karia i̱ ibilenego ko, lene.
Ani layagola wali biagome Yasu heagoria abale ibuwa ge duli hanga ho biruwa lalu, Mambo-o i̱ biamogo bia, lene.
Ani layagola Yasuhanda ladai bialu lalu, Waneigini emenenaga hina biangome nelo bape holene nawi, lene.
Ani layagola wali biagome lalu, Mambo í̠na ogoni tiga tigaore lari. Ti anduanenaga hina habane dagiani howa ibira hararu biangome mo naga ndobe, lene.

Ani layagola Yasuhanda wali biagohondo ladai bialu lalu, Í̠na mini mbiraore marume wiagadagua ndo timbuniore wu kegome hame lededagua bulebiraore, lene. Yasuhanda bi ogoni layaore dege wali biagonaga wane bayaleore hene.
Yasuhanda wali agali dewa mo dabi henego ogo
Yasu ibu dindi ogoni wahalu Galili iba timbuni bereago ange ange puabo halu bare hombene mbira wiago iraga howa berene.
Berearia wali agali dewa bu hearume ge kohebi de kohebi tingini kohebi ne hambu ndibulebi warago tara tarabe maru dewabi heba Yasunaga geha mo yalu íbu ngelayagola ibugua ti mo dabi hai halu hene.

Ani biyagola wali agali bu hearume ne hambu ndibule hearu bi lalubi tingini kohe hearu bayale hai halubi ge kohe hearu ibaga bialubi de kohe hearu de handalubi ani bialu heago hondowa mogo lowa tigua Isaraele wali agalinaga Ngode Datagaliwabe kaore lowa mini yaraga halu hene.
Agali hangu daga lalu daosini mariame (4,000) tomo no karula penego ogo

Yasuhanda ibunaga talima piaga biaru olalu, Ibidaba, lowa lalu, Wali agali o karu i̱ heba horo tebiru haabo hayagome ai áyu tomo nolene nawidago dara ho ko. Ti andaga pole pialu karia harigani de mborere buwa odope holigo i̱na tihondo tomo nami howa, Pudaba, lolene hame naleore ko, lene.
Ani layagola talima piaga biarume ibuhondo lalu, Dindi ko wali agali bu karuni no karula pelo ina tomo agohayagi tai buleberamabe, lene.
Ti ani layagola Yasuhanda tihondo lalu, Mberedi agira henedamibe, lene. Tigua lalu, Iname mberedi karia wena nde emene maru henedama, lene.
Ani layagola Yasuhanda wali agali bu hearuni, Dindini birai hadaba, lowa

ibugua mberedi karia biarubi wena emene biarubi mo yuwa Ngode Datagaliwabehondo turu halu ka̱i̱ lowa gai bu baga buwa talima piaga biaruhondo mini. Ani miyagola tigua wali agali biru wiaruhondo ta halu mini.
Ti bibahendeme tomo miyago karulape nalu no ibira hayago mialu ibunaga talima piaga biarume nu karia hono to̱lai hene.
Nenedaruni wali waneigini nale agali hangu daga lai halu daosini maria (4,000) hene.
Ani bialu Yasuhanda wali agali hearuni, Andaga pudaba, lalu iba taluni biralu dindi mbira mini Magadana wiagoha pene.
